question: When creating 10 mm single-stroke capital letters in vertical style, what does the 10 mm distance between horizontal parallel lines represent?
solution:
The correct answer is __Letter height**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Letter height__ is defined as the distance between the top and bottom horizontal parallel lines of a letter.
 
• In engineering drawing, the letter height determines the overall size of the text that is used for annotations and dimensions.
